title: WhatsApp inbox
subtitle: Conversations customers started on your store's number.
pickAThread: Pick a conversation to read it.

empty.title: No conversations yet
empty.body: When a customer messages your store's WhatsApp number, the conversation appears here — whether or not the assistant answers it.

thread.notFound: That conversation is not here any more.

delivery.sendingHint: Your reply is queued and will be emailed shortly.
delivery.sentHint: Handed to the mail server. Delivery is not confirmed.
delivery.unsentHint: This reply has not been emailed yet. If it stays like this, send it again.

reply.takesOver: Replying pauses the assistant on this conversation, so it will not answer over you.
reply.queued: Reply queued — it will arrive shortly
reply.contactFormHint: Sent by email from Zaydak in your store's name. If the customer answers, it goes to <addr>{email}</addr>, not to this inbox.
reply.contactFormUnverified: This address is not verified yet. Check it is spelled right, or the customer's answer will reach someone else.
reply.contactFormNeedsSender: To reply by email, add a sender email in notification settings. Customers' answers go to that address.
reply.emailQueued: Email queued — it will be sent shortly

resume.done: The assistant will answer this conversation again

block.done: The assistant will not answer this contact.

unblock.done: The assistant will answer this contact again.

flag.prompt: This visitor keeps hitting the reply limit. You can stop the assistant answering them.

reason.share: Using a lot of your allowance
